visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a promotional poster for a book launch titled "River of the Body" (身體之河) on a wooden stand. The camera then pans to a glass door of a building which a person pushes open to enter. (2) Inside, a young girl with pigtails and a beige top stands in a modern, brightly lit office or event space. A woman in a grey dress and blazer is seen sitting on a stage chair, gesturing during a rehearsal. (3) The scene shifts to an auditorium with rows of blue chairs; a few people are seated, waiting. The camera zooms in on the young girl who is carefully applying nail polish to her fingernails while sitting in one of the blue chairs. (4) The event begins, showing a woman (the author) sitting on stage with an older man in a suit. They are engaged in a discussion with microphones. The audience, composed of various professionals, is seated in the blue chairs, some taking photos with their phones. (5) A series of quick cuts shows the woman being introduced on stage, walking up and bowing to applause. Later, she is seen presenting a large replica of the book cover alongside several men in suits. (6) The final phase shows the woman outdoors on a street, walking past a closed storefront. She then enters a craft store filled with shelves of colorful yarn. She looks through the aisles and shows a hand-drawn sketch of a cat on a piece of paper.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, mid-tempo acoustic guitar and piano BGM. A female voice (Kelly) speaks with high energy and enthusiasm, narrating the start of the event. (2) A sharp sound of a door opening occurs, followed by a shift to indoor room tone. The female voice continues, describing the scene with her daughter. (3) The audio environment shifts to an auditorium; loud, rhythmic clapping (applause) from a crowd is heard. A male voice speaks over a microphone with a professional and calm tone, followed by Kelly's voice responding excitedly. (4) The music transitions to a more upbeat, pop-inflected track. Kelly's narration becomes faster as she describes the post-event activities. (5) Sounds of street traffic and wind noise are briefly audible as the scene transitions outdoors. (6) The final section features the sound of rustling paper and a quiet indoor atmosphere as Kelly speaks softly inside a store, with the BGM lowering in volume to emphasize her words.
